rappel_detail.anchor: natural: webbing around a horn or block; no fixed anchor reported
rappel_detail.station: The top of the short, steep low-Class-4 rock step below the East Ridge scramble.
rappel_detail.notes: A short single-rope rappel, reported as roughly 20-30 m, is common here, especially for less experienced members or when the step is wet or icy; strong parties downclimb it.
hazards: The adjacent gully can be verglassed.

set.rappels: 1 short single-rope rappel (about 20-30 m) over the rock step below the East Ridge, often downclimbed by strong parties
